notes.text: For Yitzchak, the William Davidson digital text of Chullin 99b has ben Chalov (בן חלוב), whereas the supplied notice has bar Chalov (בר חלוב).

The actual Davidson Shabbat 115b paragraph explicitly names Rav Huna bar Chalov, and the Chullin 99b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chalov. Hyman’s bar in the second pointer and the existing note are preserved. These are two lexical pointers; they do not establish a shared father or an identity between the two men.
